      PostDoc at CWI (The Netherlands),
      ACM SIGMM Director of Conference.

      I am a senior scientist in the Distributed and Interactive Systems (DIS) group at Centrum Wiskunde & Informatica (CWI).
       

      My current research is focused on user behaviour analysis and system design for immersive multimedia systems (i.e., volumetric video for XR applications). 

      Silvia Rossi, PhD
